authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10636 explicitly gives Nepali rāmro good and Western Pahari rāmṛā under its -ḍ extension. Jambu promotes this to 10636-2 *ramyaḍ-. Dotyali rāmaro fits that extension with an inserted vowel retained. Exact survey form rāməro is preserved.
